title: Fuel Filler Door Spring
introduction:
The fuel filler door spring is retained in the door assembly by a release tab. I use the open-door view for orientation, then the enlarged spring view to find the highlighted tab and withdrawal direction. The small tab is the gatekeeper here; the useful move is releasing it, not wrestling the spring out.

Have a screwdriver ready. This procedure covers releasing and refitting the illustrated spring assembly; it does not call for dismantling the spring itself.

items.name: Screwdriver
items.detail: Use it to press the spring’s retaining tab at the location shown in the enlarged illustration.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: Before working around the vehicle, disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display under Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, causing personal injury or death. Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from starting the engine during service; an accidental start may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Personal protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service. Wear protective gloves when handling parts with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to use the applicable protection may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Review applicable precautions
items.detail: Review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189) and the applicable portions of [Body Repair Health and Safety and General Precautions](#/document/G1693182) before work. This spring-release operation does not call for sanding, grinding, welding or collision repair.

edits.text: Remove the fuel filler door spring
Swing the fuel filler door open to access the spring in the fuel filler door assembly.
edits.why: The open position exposes the area shown in the spring-release illustration.

edits.text: Use a screwdriver to press the highlighted retaining tab in the direction shown in the enlarged view. With the tab released, withdraw the fuel filler door spring from the fuel filler door assembly in the illustrated direction.
edits.why: The illustration separates the tab-release movement from the spring’s withdrawal movement. Pressing the tab frees the spring’s attachment to the assembly.

edits.text: Install the fuel filler door spring
Reverse the removal sequence: insert the fuel filler door spring into its mounting in the assembly until the retaining tab engages, then close the fuel filler door.
edits.why: The engaged tab restores the spring’s retention in the assembly.
